posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Evaluation is automated for OPPE, that is the whole point of OPPE. You get instant feedback of exactly what is wrong, and you are expected to know how to debug it and get to correct solution. We do not do manual evaluation for any code in OPPE. Thus if evaluation is failing, it is due to some logical or syntax error in the code, which you can see the error message and debug. From the last submission, I can find this issue that you have not used $ before line inside the loop. For previous submissions, I do not know what the issue was, but if the script was correct – then it will give you successful evaluation, as it is automated and same for all.

posts.name: 23f3002106@ds.study.iitm.ac.in
posts.cooked:
Thank you for the clarification. I understand now that the evaluation is fully automated and consistent for all submissions. I had originally used the $ inside the loop but changed it to troubleshoot. I just wanted to understand what went wrong in that particular submission so I can avoid the same mistake in the future.

Thank you again for your time and response.
